name: Qalimo
positioning: French rental management for landlords, with bank reconciliation built in and accounting, insurance and legal services sold alongside the software.
description: Qalimo is a French rental management application for private landlords, SCI and furnished-rental owners, also sold to letting agencies, property companies and local authorities. The software covers lease drafting, digital condition reports with photographs, automatic generation and dispatch of rent receipts, tenant application screening and bank synchronisation that reconciles incoming rent automatically. Around it the editor sells accounting services for furnished rental, SCI and unfurnished rental income including filed tax returns, plus non-occupying owner insurance, rent guarantee and legal protection. Lease templates cover furnished, unfurnished, student, mobility, shared, commercial, professional and parking tenancies.
real_estate_use: The hard part of self-managed rental in France is not writing the lease, it is knowing whether the rent actually arrived and what the tax position looks like at year end. Qalimo bolts bank synchronisation onto rental management so unpaid rent surfaces without the landlord reading a bank statement, and then sells the accounting work that follows — a furnished landlord under the real regime owes a balance sheet and a filed tax package, and most do not want to produce it. Lease coverage extends past the residential lot to commercial, professional and parking tenancies, which is what brings small property companies and municipalities to it rather than a pure landlord tool.
features: Lease templates for furnished, unfurnished, student, mobility, shared, commercial, professional and parking tenancies
Automatic generation and dispatch of rent receipts
Bank synchronisation with automatic rent reconciliation
Accounting services for furnished rental, SCI and rental income, with filed tax returns

use_cases.job: See unpaid rent the day it is late through bank reconciliation instead of checking statements by hand
Run a small portfolio held in SCI or under the furnished regime and get the year-end tax package filed from the same tool
